name: comp-436
title: Browser Icon Tabs
description: Three browser-style tabs with a house, panels and box icon switch the panel below between a deploy note, a project status list and package versions.
use: Switching between a few app views when you want a familiar browser-tab feel.
avoid: When many tabs are needed: only three fit comfortably and the row scrolls instead of stacking.
a11y: Labelled tabs with hidden icons give clean names and the panel text is real text; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Flat-topped tabs with rounded upper corners and thin side borders sit along a hairline baseline on black, each with a small icon and label. The selected tab reads brighter and covers the line; below, small text or a two-column list fills the panel.
behaves: Clicking a tab lifts it above the baseline and swaps the panel between a deployment note, a project list and package versions. Unchosen tabs fall back to dim grey.
customise: Each tab's label, icon and panel contents are written into the file, so a data-driven version means rewriting the triggers and panels. Active styling is class-based.
weight: light: Three tabs and a few short text panels; one lightweight state swap.
